preguntas.respuesta: We are an at-home diagnostic testing service: we send you a kit so you can collect your own sample at home, with no appointment and no needles. The sample is analysed in a lab and you get your results clearly explained in the app, with recommendations on what to discuss with your doctor.

No. Our results are information for you and to share with a healthcare professional, not a medical diagnosis. We give you clear signals and recommendations so your conversation with your doctor is better informed, but clinical assessment and any medical decision always belong to a professional.

It depends on the test, but it is always designed for you to do it yourself at home: a finger-prick (a drop of blood from your finger), a urine sample or a self-collected swab, depending on the biomarker. The kit includes step-by-step instructions and everything you need, with no need to visit any centre.
